decisions.reason: The multi-release series still has unresolved upside and manageable retention costs, so the option remains worth keeping open.
The jazz vinyl reissue is a low-cost option in a proven niche, and without clear negative signals the firm keeps the option open.
The box set ties up more capital and its demand is uncertain, but it still offers option value if collector interest materializes, so it is kept with a moderate chance of dropping.
The generic compilation CD's option value has likely been resolved without evidence of success, making abandonment the best use of resources.
